name: Rainbow Icon
description: Cycles your icon's secondary color through RGB with glow, like Mega Hack's rainbow icon.

speed.name: Speed (cycles per second)
speed.description: How fast the hue cycles. 0.3 is roughly one full loop every 3 seconds.

palette-sync.name: Sync nearest palette color (Globed, experimental)
palette-sync.description: Also sets your real saved Color 2 + glow to the closest palette color, so mods that send your icon colors (like Globed) can pick it up. Palette only has ~107 colors, so it looks steppy to others. Your original color is restored when you turn this off.
